payload.description:
Purpose: finish 8f98f8 so ComputerTurnJobs complete on an ephemeral Fargate host instead of nacking ComputerWorkerHostNotReady.

Acceptance:
- Summoned task runs the host pull worker (not sleep infinity as the effective command).
- ChromiumActionExecutor is the live ComputerActionExecutor on that host.
- Host publishes readiness so the computer-queue worker can deliver the job.
- Same durable turn continues exactly once with tool.result.
- ChatticusComputers desiredCount stays 0. No cdk deploy --all, no production, no Snapshots/Computers destroy.
- Do not touch 35d86b / PR #26.
payload.title: Chromium executor and host-readiness on summoned Fargate
